This is my personal blogging website. Particularly in the field of agricultural economics, I have a keen interest in data analysis in R. Thus, I plan to blog important notes on some questions to make it easier for young researchers like me.

***

I have an MSc in Agricultural Economics from Ondokuz Mayis University, Turkey. I am currently pursuing an International MSc in Rural Development through the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Degree program hosted by Ghent University, Belgium. You can check [here](https://guturago.github.io/about) to know more about my academic journey.

***

* You can find all of my blog posts [here.](https://guturago.github.io/blog)
* I have developed a R package to search, browse, and export metadata for microdata published by five international organizations, and you can find it [here.](https://guturago.github.io/microData)
